description: Create a new ABAP domain in SAP system. Creates the domain object in initial state.

conversion_exit.description: (optional) Conversion exit routine name (without CONVERSION_EXIT_ prefix)

datatype.description: (optional) Data type: CHAR, NUMC, DATS, TIMS, DEC, INT1, INT2, INT4, INT8, CURR, QUAN, etc.

decimals.description: (optional) Decimal places (for DEC, CURR, QUAN types)

description.description: (optional) Domain description. If not provided, domain_name will be used.

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

fixed_values.description: (optional) Array of fixed values for domain value range

text.description: Description text for the fixed value

master_language.description: Optional master/original language for the created object (e.g. "EN", "DE", "ZH"). Defaults to the session language (SAP_LANGUAGE) or EN.

transport_request.description: (optional) Transport request number, not a task. Required for transportable packages.

value_table.description: (optional) Value table name for foreign key relationship

name: CreateDomain
